incident: Expired TLS certificate on payment provider
symptoms: TLS handshake failures began at midnight
recent_changes: See root-cause context; synthetic historical incident.
root_cause: The client trust path encountered an expired provider certificate that had not been renewed.
successful_steps: Escalated to provider and switched to the documented fallback endpoint
resolution: The payment provider certificate expired. The application was healthy; certificate validation blocked connections until the provider renewed the certificate/fallback was used.
postmortem: Restarting did not change certificate validity.
API key rotation was unrelated to TLS validation.
